question: Which schema and renderer contracts should HTML ingress and static output share, and which interactive dependencies can be removed?

trigger: User asked whether to agree with the attached last-pass critique of the completed content-root locations design. Assessment only.
requirements: Use the existing scoped editor and root-relative paths; supplied callback entries must resolve in their own document and root.
Preserve immutable document and read-only binding, independent mounted-view state, and the implicit primary root law.
Prioritize the evidenced shipped view-derivation and known-path List/Table presentation jobs; do not restart design.

evidenceReuse: Reused the bound design and its probes plus the matching 2026-09-30-content-root-locations-last-pass lookup. Rechecked Vision, createEditorViewRuntime, EditorPreview/static copy, automatic owned-root mounting, EditorRoot/PliteRuntimeView, authored runtime reads, discussion cache and retained-fragment creation. summary: Pursue execution, retaining the scoped-editor target and the last-pass ordering: view derivation, independent known-path List/Table reads, bounded static root delivery and decoration repairs, then affected final-tree proof. The earlier missing-contract framing and fixture-led prioritization were overstated. Correct the last-pass authored-policy claim: EditorRoot explicitly reads readAuthoredView(editor), passes that default to PliteRuntimeView, and its layout effect configures the mounted view. Automatic mounts therefore already have an initial authored-policy inheritance path; a universal reset-to-edit claim is not established. Defaults memoized by editor identity leave live parent-mode propagation as an unexecuted focused interaction check, not a proven suggestion leak. Inherit required policy/source definitions while keeping focus, selection, managers and observers exact-view. Delete owner resolution only when it is redundant: discussion keys its proposed-reader cache by runtime owner and retained-fragment creation intentionally binds another authored context. Narrow source review to canonical/relative range boundaries, including absent roots; a search only for explicitly written roots misses the primary-root interpretation issue. Original pp4 has two pass and two inconclusive cells; a post-hoc 1.25 attribution guard does not satisfy the original 1.20 acceptance.

alternatives: Another architecture/design pass or a new location carrier/provider/view manager: Stop. Existing view authority and accepted design already solve the contract.

Execute with shipped view derivation and known-path List/Table presentation first: Pursue. Both have current consumers and the existing bounded probes; owned-root delivery remains a public-capability correctness repair.

Assume automatic mounts always reset authored mode and add broad configuration inheritance: Stop as stated. EditorRoot already seeds authored policy. Check initial and later mode changes; inherit policy/source definitions, not exact-view lifecycle state.

Delete both getEditorRuntimeOwner calls mechanically: Stop as stated. Retain per-runtime cache identity and retained-fragment semantics; remove only redundant factory flattening after the caller contract passes.

Narrow S3 to a search for ranges with explicit roots: Stop as stated. Canonical rootless inputs mean primary while rootless emitted decorations mean the current reader; include these boundaries in the census and focused checks.
proofLimits: Source inspection and reused prior evidence only. No product code or plan edits, new test, typecheck or browser reproduction. The projected-copy failure remains source-traced plus an existing composition probe, not a reproduced clipboard interaction. Initial authored-policy forwarding is a source fact; live mode-change behavior and suggestion recording in an owned root are unexecuted. Cache and fragment semantics caution against unconditional deletion; no caller mutation was tested. pp4 statuses come from retained receipts and acceptance scripts, not a fresh run.
